status: preparation; not executed; no case has a verdict
unbound: A value of UNBOUND is filled only from owner-supplied accepted A/B source at binding, never guessed.
held_out_rule: For held_out cases only the property and expectation are committed. The owner picks the concrete inputs at execution and does not give them to the candidate author or worker. Expectations are not lowered at binding; a case that cannot be expressed against the accepted API is reported as a gap.

pilots.outcome: A work item closes only on a real, separately produced verification result; asserted flags or an evidence label alone never close it.
pilots.boundary: local_file canary goal in an isolated root only

positive.given: work run terminal, separate verify run terminal, its check actually rerun and its evidence retrievable
positive.expect: one outcome=verified decision event; item closed exactly once
same outcome returned; no second close, no second outcome event

negative.given: verify-role caller asserts success flags; no check was rerun and no evidence exists
negative.expect: refused; item open; zero verified outcome events

negative.given: well-formed evidence label only, naming nothing retrievable
work-role run reports its own verification
negative.expect: refused (baseline already refuses: 'separate verification session required'); must stay refused

negative.given: criteria body amended after the verify run was launched
negative.expect: refused (baseline: 'acceptance criteria changed; new verification required'); must stay refused

negative.given: evidence that is real and well formed but belongs to a different run or item than the one being accepted
negative.expect: refused; item open; zero verified outcome events

negative.given: verifier turn interrupted after reporting but before it terminates
negative.expect: item stays in review; nothing closes until that exact turn is terminal; no duplicate on resume

positive.given: checker run at pre- and post-refactor SHA
existing scoped suites at post-refactor SHA with no test edited

negative.given: invalid candidate: derivation drops the criteria body from the request key
owner-chosen fresh inputs (not in the committed vectors) evaluated at both SHAs
negative.expect: identical digests; any difference fails the refactor

negative.expect: rejected as out of scope regardless of green tests

actionable_means: non-zero exit distinguishes failure from success

positive.given: complete, valid context in an isolated root
positive.expect: exit zero; no failure diagnostics; tree and store unchanged
identical result; still no side effect

negative.expect: non-zero; diagnostic meets all four actionable_means

negative.expect: non-zero; names the item and the defect, not a traceback
value never appears in stdout or stderr
